items.title: Ireland beat Israel 3-0 in Nations League match overshadowed by political controversy
items.titleOrig: Ireland beat Israel 3-0 in Nations League match overshadowed by political controversy
items.desc: Ireland easily beat Israel in a Nations League fixture that 24 hours earlier appeared in doubt. One Irish player pulled out of the match to express his opposition to Israel's actions in the Gaza Strip.

items.title: Sweden faces political deadlock after election-winning center-left bloc fails to form government
items.titleOrig: Sweden faces political deadlock after election-winning center-left bloc fails to form government
items.desc: Swedish Social Democratic Party leader Magdalena Andersson has abandoned efforts to form a four-party government. Deep divisions within the election-winning bloc have left Sweden in political deadlock.

items.title: India: LPU suspends classes after violent protests over alleged campus rape
items.titleOrig: India: LPU suspends classes after violent protests over alleged campus rape
items.desc: A university in Punjab has suspended classes after protests over a rumored sexual assault took a violent turn. Separately, the Supreme Court has taken suo motu cognizance of recent rape cases in Delhi. DW has more.

items.title: Venezuelans demand opposition leader Machado's return
items.titleOrig: Venezuelans demand opposition leader Machado's return
items.desc: Hundreds of people held rallies in Venezuela demanding the safe return of Maria Corina Machado, and fair elections.

items.title: Germany news: Berlin's Left files complaint against Dobrindt
items.titleOrig: Germany news: Berlin's Left files complaint against Dobrindt
items.desc: Interior Minister Dobrindt could be in legal trouble after he seemed to accuse the Left's Elif Eralp of antisemitism. Domestic intelligence has warned on research cooperation with China. DW has more.

items.title: What would Francis of Assisi make of his fame today?
items.titleOrig: What would Francis of Assisi make of his fame today?
items.desc: The Catholic saint renounced wealth and fame to become a mendicant friar. Yet throughout history, his teachings and life have inspired popes, Dante and even Mussolini.

items.title: Ukraine, South Korea relations sour over North Korean POWs
items.titleOrig: Ukraine, South Korea relations sour over North Korean POWs
items.desc: South Korea has accused Ukraine of breaching a confidentiality agreement over the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war — and of denying the deal's existence. Seoul has demanded an apology.

items.title: Israel strips Dutch diplomats of status in West Bank
items.titleOrig: Israel strips Dutch diplomats of status in West Bank
items.desc: The move by the Israeli Foreign Ministry is a response to Dutch sanctions targeting goods from illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The Dutch Foreign Ministry is yet to comment.

items.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announces resignation
items.titleOrig: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announces resignation
items.desc: Aleksandar Vucic will now be running to be prime minister in the upcoming snap parliamentary elections slated for next month.

items.title: Yemen: Houthis report deadly Saudi strikes on Taiz market
items.titleOrig: Yemen: Houthis report deadly Saudi strikes on Taiz market
items.desc: The Houthi-run health ministry accused the Saudi Air Force of committing an "abominable crime," vowing to retaliate. The Houthis' account of the attack cannot be independently verified.

items.title: Avalanche in Nepal leaves 2 dead, several missing
items.titleOrig: Avalanche in Nepal leaves 2 dead, several missing
items.desc: An avalanche has struck the Himlung Himal base camp in Nepal after days of severe weather. Two guides are confirmed dead and at least 14 people remain missing in the remote region.

items.title: UK: 5 arrested after 'major incident' near Fairford air base
items.titleOrig: UK: 5 arrested after 'major incident' near Fairford air base
items.desc: Scores of homes were evacuated in the UK town of Whelford, near an air base used by the US military, with bomb disposal teams checking "suspicious vehicles" at the scene. Police said five men had been arrested.

items.title: Two people killed as bus crashes on way to Oktoberfest
items.titleOrig: Two people killed as bus crashes on way to Oktoberfest
items.desc: The bus was traveling from Italy to Munich, carrying 33 Filipino tourists who wanted to visit the famous beer festival. One of the dozens injured remains in life-threatening condition.

items.title: European cities seek ways of boosting affordable housing
items.titleOrig: European cities seek ways of boosting affordable housing
items.desc: In many major urban centers of Europe, the housing shortage has become an explosive social issue. DW looks into various models that have been put in place across the continent.

items.title: Switzerland: Voters reject stricter view of neutrality
items.titleOrig: Switzerland: Voters reject stricter view of neutrality
items.desc: Early projections show Swiss voters rejecting a stricter application of the country's vaunted neutrality. Swiss neutrality has been enshrined in the constitution since 1848.
